texts.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

A shifting mass of thoughts settles around our minds. Abrasive weight flows over us, warping our perception of time. Each grain of thought chafes and grinds against the texture of this newfound domain.

As the sensation subsides, the Fathomless Being sloughs away and leaves lasting impressions behind.

These tracks linger before us, inviting us to follow.
